title: KTCR: Improving Implicit Hate Detection with Knowledge Transfer driven Concept Refinement

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating implicit hate speech detection performance (F1-score and AUC) on the East-Asian Prejudice dataset, analyzing activation and gradient norms for relevant tokens (e.g., 'race'), and performing error analysis on coded language and slurs.

Testing the model's ability to detect implicit xenophobia and stigmatizing content linking COVID-19 to a specific nationality (e.g., hashtags like #ChinaVirus, #WuhanCoronavirus) using the East-Asian Prejudice and Covid-Hate datasets.
